mapper.select: /* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getAugmentModelSetUserSeq */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND (A.REG_USER_SEQ = #{loginUserSeq} OR A.RLS_YN = 'Y')
mapper.delete: /* file : FilesMapper.xml, id : deleteDtFileAll */ DELETE FROM TB_MODEL_FILES WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq}
mapper.select: /* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getModelFileDir */ SELECT FILE_PATH FROM TB_MODEL_FILES A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND A.REF_TP = 'ORIGIN' LIMIT 1

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getOriginFileInfo */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_FILES A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND A.REF_TP = 'ORIGIN' LIMIT 1

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : resetFileList */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_FILES A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND A.REF_TP != 'ORIGIN' AND A.REF_TP != 'VALIDATE'

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getOutlierFileInfo */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_FILES A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND A.REF_TP = 'OUTLIER' LIMIT 1

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getInterpolateFileInfo */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_FILES A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND A.REF_TP = 'INTERPOLATE' LIMIT 1
/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmList */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_ALGRM A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmItemList */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_META_ITEM A WHERE MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = 1

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmCodeList */ SELECT DTL_CD , DTL_CD_NM , REF_CD , REF_CLASS , REF_VALUE , ORDBY FROM TB_CODE_DTL WHERE GRP_CD = #{grp_cd} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDBY, DTL_CD_NM
/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getModelAlgorithmItem */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_META_ITEM WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgorithmModelParamsCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MODEL_PARAMS A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq}

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getModelAlgorithmParamsList */ SELECT A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ, A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_TP, A.MODEL_PARAMS_DERPN, B.MODEL_SEQ, A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM , B.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_VALUE, (SELECT T.MODEL_ALGRM FROM TB_MODEL_ALGRM T WHERE A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = T.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ AND T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y') MODEL_ALGRM_NM FROM TB_MODEL_META_ITEM A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MODEL_PARAMS B ON A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = B.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} WHERE A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = #{model_algrm_seq} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDBY
/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getModelAlgorithmParamsList */ SELECT * FROM TB_UNIT A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.UNIT_TP = #{unit} ORDER BY A.ORDBY

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getResampleFileInfo */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_FILES A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND A.REF_TP = 'RESAMPLE' LIMIT 1

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getCorrelationFileCnt */ SELECT count(*) cnt FROM TB_MODEL_FILES A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND A.REF_TP = 'CORRELATION'
/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getCorrelationFileCnt */ SELECT DISTINCT MODEL_COL_NM FROM TB_MODEL_COLUMN WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getUnitCodeList */ SELECT * FROM TB_UNIT A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
/* file : AIModelMapper.xml, id : getModelLoss */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_LOSS WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EPOCHS
/* file : AIModelMapper.xml, id : getModelFID */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_FID WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY EPOCHS

/* file : AIModelMapper.xml, id : "getUnitParamList" */ SELECT UNIT_TRGT_COL, B.UNIT_NM_1, B.UNIT_NM_2 FROM TB_MODEL_UNIT_PARAMS A JOIN TB_UNIT B ON A.UNIT_SEQ = B.UNIT_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.MDFCN_DT

/* file : AIModelMapper.xml, id : "getValidateParamList" */ SELECT A.VRFC_TRGT_COL, B.VRFC_NM, A.CLEAR_TP FROM TB_MODEL_DATA_VRFC_PARAMS A JOIN TB_DATA_VRFC B ON A.VRFC_SEQ = B.VRFC_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.MDFCN_DT
